QuestInfo.name: Looking for the Red Cape
QuestInfo.1: Pia's friend has decided to go on an adventure and she wants to bring back a gift! She needs 5 Dragon Skins and 10 Screws#k to make a neat claw. She also needs the #bRed Cape#k that Rina in Henesys borrowed. Pia will probably give you a reward.
QuestInfo.2: I decided to go to Rina to get the #bRed Cape#k back, which she has borrowed from Pia.

0.0: You seem pretty tough. Think you're up for a little challenge?
0.1: One of my friends in Ellinia wanted to be a thief. After some training, he will start traveling... I would like to give him something special for him! So I asked #p1052002# in #m103000000# to make a good claw and he wanted some weird stuff to make it.
0.2: So can you get the materials, which #p1052002# wants? I'd like to get them by myself, but I can't move, because of this stupid clothing! Of course, I will pay you, if you do this for me... If you are not busy, can you please help me?

yes.0: I knew you'd do it! I need 5 #t4000030#s and 10 #t4003000#s#k. Also, I need a cape! Definitely going to need a cape. Can you get the #b#t4031043##k I let #p1010100# in #m100000000# borrow a few days ago? Get me these items, and I should be able to make something great for my friend's trip!

no.0: You must be very busy... If you have time later, please get back to me My friend will start traveling soon...

1.0: It's the perfect time of year for an adventure!

npc.0: I thought you were gonna bring me stuff! Bring me 1 #b#t4031043#, 5 #t4000030#s, and 10 #t4003000#s#k! Thanks, you're a real pal! Oh, don't forget, I lent the #t4031043# to #p1010100# in #m100000000#!
